purpose: Separate training-content eligibility from executable-task eligibility so repository execution support cannot silently become a curation gate.

training_content.C1: passes license, content, provenance, split, hazard, generated-file, and benchmark-quarantine gates

execution_support.E1: frozen isolated execution candidate attempted but task-class-specific reproducibility verification not established
execution_support.E2: the frozen isolated execution protocol passes the task-class-specific reproducibility contract

task_class_e2_contracts.repository_patch: the same frozen isolated command passes on both parent and merge commits
task_class_e2_contracts.function_generation: the frozen isolated evaluator, dependency image, public tests, and hidden tests pass on the reference solution and the evaluator rejects at least one frozen negative control
task_class_e2_contracts.other: requires a separately frozen task-class-specific reproducibility contract before Stage-C entry

stage_entry_rules.stage_0_training_content: requires C1; execution tier is irrelevant
stage_entry_rules.executable_stage_c_task: requires E2; training-content tier is irrelevant
stage_entry_rules.utility: Stage C validation only; never selector objective

decision_rules: C1/E0 and C1/E1 records may remain training-data candidates but cannot become executable Stage-C tasks
C0/E2 bundles may support executable evaluation but cannot enter training
execution failure cannot imply Stage-B, curation, or Utility failure
executable-task acquisition may use a separately prevalidated task harness
human_or_llm_review: optional diagnostic only; never ground truth, tuning signal, or entry gate
claim_boundary: Execution-support taxonomy only; no Utility, curation-benefit, or release claim.
